q: We supply ten buyers who all want carbon data. Can we prepare it once?
title: Share carbon data once with many buyers
short: Mostly yes. Build one inventory with Scope 1 and 2, product figures and their sources, then map it to each buyer's form. Formats differ, but the numbers underneath should not. Data exchange standards such as the PACT methodology help when buyers support them.
audience: Suppliers answering carbon requests from several customers

ul: One period, usually the last financial year.
Product figures with allocation rules written down.

p: Keep a short note of how each buyer's fields map to your base data, so answers stay consistent.
Some buyers accept a standard product footprint file; others insist on their portal.

The GHG Protocol's supplier engagement guidance makes the same point to buyers: separate spreadsheets are simple but inefficient for a supplier filling several surveys, and a common system lets data be collected once and used many times.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
